neighbours.label: a word that opens an elaboration, evidence or qualification of the preceding claim ('that is,', 'as evidenced by', 'in the sense', 'can only be obtained')
fire: She is an early adopter, that is, someone who buys every gadget on launch day.
The team's defence has improved, as evidenced by just two goals conceded in May.
He was rich, though not rich in the sense that most people imagine.
True calm can only be reached through years of patient practice.
The policy failed, as shown by the sharp rise in complaints last year.
Our town is quiet, which is to say, nothing much happens after eight.
The region's prosperity was reflected in its grand churches and markets.
Their loyalty was evident, as demonstrated by the long queue outside the shop.
quiet: She is an early adopter and buys every gadget on launch day.
